ORIGINAL miniboss design sheet for an abyssal sea-floor mobile tower-defense game. Concept: THE VENT CRAB, a giant cartoon deep-sea crab that lives near hydrothermal vents and protects an ancient pearl. Original IP only.

Design: broad low crab body, oversized asymmetrical claws, coral and barnacle growths on shell, glowing cyan eyes, one magma-orange vent crack across shell, little anemones on back, thick segmented legs, cute but dangerous expression. Palette: dark teal shell, coral pink/red, cyan bioluminescence, small magma orange accents.

Create consistent top-down/3-4 source sheet:
1 dormant half-buried in sand,
2 awakening,
3 active idle,
4 claw slam anticipation,
5 claw slam impact,
6 bubble-blow/steam attack,
7 hit/stagger.
Same anatomy, proportions and camera angle. Chunky casual-game cartoon, clean outlines, soft cel shading, mobile-readable, no gore, no text, no UI.
